scope: Deep public-source recheck of existing sUAS qualified-cell TARGET; append one OBSERVE history; no new TARGET

history.target_detail: FEOC 비의존·NDAA 적격 고에너지밀도 sUAS 셀의 고객인증 양산·배정 능력
history.reason: AMPX의 미국 정부 OTA·DIU 기반 NDAA/FEOC 대응 공급망·국내 생산능력 확대와 SES의 NDAA-compliant drone-cell 라인 ramp·고객 qualification/pipeline을 원문 중심으로 재검토했다. 수요·공급 신호는 강하지만 동일 규격·동일 기간의 firm customer need가 고객인증 양품 잔여 공급을 초과한다는 자료가 없어 OBSERVE 유지.
history.summary: AMPX는 계약-backed 국내 생산확대가 확인되고 SES는 1m cells/year NDAA-compliant ramp와 고객 line audit/qualification이 확인된다. 그러나 고객별 firm orders, 공통 SKU, accepted yield, allocations와 residual qualified supply가 없어 산업 병목은 미입증.
history.demand_evidence: 미국 방산 sUAS용 NDAA/FEOC 대응 수요 방향은 명확하다. AMPX 고객들의 미군 downstream awards와 DIU/정부 계약, SES의 미국·동맹 drone maker line audits·qualification pipeline이 확인된다. 다만 downstream program award나 pipeline을 AMPX/SES의 firm cell orders로 바꾸지 않는다.
history.constraint_evidence: SES는 Korea NDAA-compliant line을 연 1m cells 수준으로 ramp한다고 공시했고 management call에서 usable output 700k–800k와 top-five potential need 약1.5m을 언급했으나 이는 pipeline/운영 가정이며 firm orders와 동일하지 않다. AMPX acCELLerate의 초기 domestic nameplate capacity·cell count는 SEC 계약서에서 redacted라 산업 전체 적격 공급량을 계산할 수 없다.
history.relief_evidence: AMPX Project acCELLerate의 정부 지원 domestic high-volume production build, 미국 contract-manufacturing partner 확대, SES의 1m/year Korea line 및 추가 NDAA-compliant capacity 탐색은 모두 공급완화 경로다. 실제 customer-qualified good-cell increment와 가동일은 별도 UNKNOWN.
history.demand_timing: 2026~2028 customer qualification/order conversion 및 U.S. defense procurement ramp 신호는 있으나 2027/2028/2029 customer×SKU별 binding cell quantities와 need dates는 UNKNOWN.
history.supply_timing: SES는 Q4 2026 full-capacity 1m/year 목표와 추가 capacity 탐색을 공시. AMPX acCELLerate는 시설 retrofit·equipment·validation milestones가 있으나 redacted 일정/절대 nameplate 때문에 2027~2029 accepted residual supply는 UNKNOWN.

companies.name: Amprius Technologies
companies.scope: Signed U.S. Government Project acCELLerate OTA targets secure scalable domestic silicon-anode HED pouch-cell production for sUAS Groups 1–3; separate DIU/NDAA-compliant drone-battery work and U.S. manufacturing partners support supply expansion.
companies.confirmed_orders: Government OTA total amount USD74,793,173.11; base funded USD22.3m. This is project funding/milestone payment authority, not a same-value cell purchase order.
companies.qualified_capacity: UNKNOWN — contract nameplate MWh/year and approximate million cells/year are redacted; customer-accepted good-cell output and free allocation UNKNOWN.

companies.name: SES AI
companies.scope: Korea drone-format line converted and ramping toward ~1m NDAA-compliant cells/year; sample shipments, U.S./allied drone-maker line audits and order-securing efforts into 2028 are disclosed.
companies.confirmed_orders: UNKNOWN for defense-drone cell annual quantities. Management pipeline statements and audits are not treated as firm purchase orders.
companies.qualified_capacity: Company plan/statement: ~1m cells/year nameplate at full ramp; actual customer-accepted deliverable output, product mix and residual free capacity UNKNOWN.

excluded_claims.statement: SES top-five NDAA drone prospects imply ~1.5m cells/year versus ~700k–800k deliverable output
excluded_claims.reason: The Q2 earnings-call statement concerns pipeline/potential customer need and management-estimated usable output, not signed same-SKU annual purchase obligations or customer-qualified allocated supply.

excluded_claims.statement: AMPX customers received approximately USD500m of U.S. military awards, therefore AMPX has USD500m of battery orders
excluded_claims.reason: The company described downstream awards to longstanding defense customers as visibility into potential future cell purchase orders; the awards are not AMPX cell orders.

excluded_claims.statement: Project acCELLerate total OTA amount equals guaranteed AMPX battery revenue
excluded_claims.reason: The agreement is milestone-based prototype-project funding for facility/equipment/validation work; base funding and total government share are not equivalent to delivered-cell revenue.

decisive_unknowns: customer×SKU별 firm purchase quantity, need date and cancellation/option terms
NDAA/Section842/FEOC compliance mapped to each cell BOM and customer acceptance
AMPX acCELLerate redacted nameplate MWh/cell throughput and validated good-cell yield
SES actual post-ramp usable output by qualified SKU and signed defense orders
industry-wide qualified alternatives, inventory, reservations and residual free capacity
customer qualification completion dates, requalification burden and production allocation

blockers: same SKU/specification and same period firm demand not matched to accepted good-cell supply
customer-qualified output/yield and allocation by supplier are not public
SES pipeline statement is not a firm-order shortage proof
AMPX domestic expansion is material relief but absolute qualified residual capacity is redacted/unknown

history.company_comparison_note: For economic-linkage evidence only, AMPX has the stronger signed government-backed domestic-capacity connection; SES has a large disclosed compliant-capacity ramp and customer qualification pipeline. This is not an equity ranking and neither proves a market-wide bottleneck.
history.next_check: Match named customer/SKU firm orders and delivery dates against AMPX/SES customer-qualified good-cell output, yield, reservations and inventory; verify acCELLerate IOC/validation milestones and SES line-audit conversions into signed orders.
